a2-review-1.R1.1 Sweet Kate:
Narrator: It's a Saturday in March. Megan is in Chicago for a conference, and she's at Sweet Kate with Tom.
Tom: Megan, this is my sister Kate. Kate, this is Megan, my old friend from college.
Kate: Hi Megan! Welcome to Sweet Kate. Tom has talked about you all week.
Megan: Hi! What a beautiful bakery! And it smells amazing in here.
Kate: Thank you! Try this cinnamon roll. It's still warm.
Megan: Mmm, it tastes delicious! How long have you had the bakery?
Kate: For eight years. A few months ago someone hacked our email, so now I avoid using the same password twice!
Lucy: Hi everyone! Sorry I'm late.
Tom: Lucy! You've taken off your cast!
Lucy: Yes, I've just come from the doctor. My arm feels a little weak, but it's OK.
Megan: Oh no, what happened?
Lucy: I fell off my bike in January. A car door opened right in front of me.
Megan: I'm a nurse, so I've seen a lot of bike accidents. I'm glad you're OK.
Tom: Oh, Paulo is calling. Hi Paulo! You're on speaker.
Paulo: Hi everyone! I'm in Central Park with a group of tourists. We're forest bathing!
Kate: Megan, have you ever done that?
Megan: No, I haven't. But I'd like to try it.
Paulo: You should! And guess what? Ana and Marcos have just come back from Florida. Ana swam with manatees!
Tom: Wow, that's amazing. Good for her!
Paulo: OK, I have to go. Say hi to Pancake for me!
Megan: Pancake? So... what's he like?
Tom: He's lazy, friendly and always hungry. Just like me!

a2-review-1.R1.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Lucy: That dress really suits you! Where did you get it?
Kate: Thanks! Actually, my mom gave it to me.
Lucy: What a beautiful color! And congratulations on eight years of Sweet Kate!
Kate: You're too kind. It was a team effort.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Megan: Sorry, how do you say this word? K-N-I-F-E.
Tom: Knife. The K is silent.
Megan: And what does crumb mean?
Tom: It's a very small piece of bread or cake.
Megan: What kind of word is it?
Tom: It's a noun. One crumb, two crumbs.
